strategy: Existing DOM for wrapped footer <=2097152 bytes; reviewed forward reader above that bound
scope: Retained contexts and cached indexed random reads only, no streaming/load/decompression reruns
sustained_cases: Previous nine flagged pairs plus real IM at one reader
gate: Inspect three-repetition medians of worker loop separately from global read phase (includes destruction/join) and complete open/read/close workload. Flag >5% slower; investigate, disclose, never select fastest repetitions.
cpu_placement: Primary workers0..95 at every N, matching reused baseline; sustained workers0..N-1; driver96..127;96logical=64physical+32SMT
allocator: Default environment, no mallopt/malloc_trim/allocator environment tuning
rejected_experiments: All-reader, direct fragment copy removal, packed IDs and preallocated packed IDs are separately retained and excluded from final candidate comparisons
